title: Dark Disciple Master
summary: Survive the Dark Disciple Master's escalating undead reinforcements.
overview: Survive the Dark Disciple Master's escalating undead reinforcements.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Have add control ready before the first random threshold and save recovery for the final two waves.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: A randomly selected threshold between 60% and 70% health raises Plavo's remains.
At 30%, three disciples rise; at 20%, another three arrive and the master casts Spiritual Echo.
At 19%, the master casts Protection of Discord III.
The event has a thirty-minute cleanup timer from spawn; victory creates its quest chest.

notes: Approval E394. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
